title: claude-code hook stdin contract
description: Seam 1 of the adapter's invocation plumbing: the snake_case hook input Claude Code writes to a command hook's stdin. Grounded in payloads captured from Claude Code 2.1.323 on Linux, which are authoritative: every event carries the conversation's `session_id`, `cwd` and `hook_event_name`; every event fired inside a subagent also carries that subagent's `agent_id` and `agent_type`; the main thread's events carry the selected agent's `agent_type`; tool events carry `tool_name`, `tool_input` and `tool_use_id`. Deliberately permissive (unknown fields allowed): the runtime adds fields between releases and the adapter reads only the keys tools.yaml names, failing closed on a tool call it cannot read.

session_id.description: The conversation: shared by the main thread and every subagent inside it.

hook_event_name.description: The firing event (SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, Stop, SessionEnd, …).

cwd.description: The working directory of the session (absolute).

prompt_id.description: The user prompt the firing belongs to: stamps the turn session (H0).

agent_id.description: SubagentStart/SubagentStop: the subagent's id; inside a subagent: its own id.

agent_type.description: The agent acting: the subagent's, or the main thread's selected agent ('<plugin>:<agent>' for a plugin agent).

tool_use_id.description: The tool call's id: the same on its pre- and post-tool events.

tool_response.description: PostToolUse: the tool's result (for the `Agent` tool: its `status` and the returning subagent's `agentId`).

source.description: SessionStart: startup, resume, clear or compact.
